parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem:
An analogue voltmeter is used to take measurements of a constant potential difference across a resistor.

For these measurements, describe **one** example of

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: The potential difference across a resistor is measured as $5.0\text{ V} \pm 0.1\text{ V}$. The resistor is labelled as having a resistance of $125\Omega \pm 3\%$.
parts.text: Calculate the power dissipated by the resistor.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the percentage uncertainty in the calculated power.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the value of the power, with its absolute uncertainty, to an appropriate number of significant figures.
